t: Heavy duty fixing for use in plasterboard, most hollow concrete block, cavity walls and ceilings. Covers a range of wall thicknesses from 12.5mm to 45mm and supports from 30kg (in plasterboard) up to 60kg (in block). Supplied with 40mm and 60mm screw lengths.
b: Suitable for Hanging Radiators, Kitchen Cabinets & TV Mounting
